name: Projectile velocity vs gravity
teacher: Separate horizontal/vertical motion; velocity can be horizontal while acceleration remains downward.
renderer: Field + clocked native objects
majestic: Downward glowing acceleration field and one projectile; no annotations.
explanatory: Parabola, ground, velocity arrow on the body and gravity probe.

name: Oscillator phase portrait
teacher: Follow turning points and energy; acceleration opposes displacement, not velocity.
renderer: Field + exact clocked marker; Physics Lab for the differential-equation analysis
majestic: Energy-colored state flow and one timed state marker.
explanatory: Displacement–velocity plane, energy contours and derivative probe; 3D is explicitly a view of that plane.

name: Circular velocity vs centripetal acceleration
teacher: Vary radius and angular speed; constant speed does not mean zero acceleration.
renderer: Field + clocked native objects
majestic: Glowing rotating annulus and one marker.
explanatory: Circular path, tangent velocity and inward acceleration, separately interpreted units.

name: Continuity and Bernoulli streamtube
teacher: Compare area, flow speed and pressure; narrow does not mean slow or high pressure.
renderer: Exact field preset; Fluid tab is a separate viscous comparison
majestic: Glowing stream inside a cutaway tube.
explanatory: Walls, exact planar streamlines and velocity probe; explain cross-section pressure variation.

name: Neutral conductor in uniform E
teacher: Polarization redirects E; zero field inside does not require zero surface charge.
renderer: Field preset + native sphere
majestic: Glowing exterior field and one conducting sphere.
explanatory: Sphere, exact meridional flux contours and E probe; move the probe inside.

name: Changing flux and induced E
teacher: Compare B with its rate of change; large B alone does not imply a large induced emf.
renderer: Time-dependent field + clocked native objects
majestic: Reversing glowing circulation and a flux-region rim.
explanatory: Flux boundary, B-direction marker and E probe; compare inside/outside loops.

name: Motion graphs and reference frames
teacher: Link position, slope and acceleration; a descending position graph need not mean slowing down.
renderer: Desmos objects only + clock
majestic: Minimal moving marker and its trail; no artificial physical-space flow.
explanatory: Synchronized x(t), v(t), a(t), with a reference-frame velocity slider.

name: Incline free-body diagram and friction threshold
teacher: Increase incline angle; static friction is an adjustable reaction, not always μsN.
renderer: Native objects and arrows; Physics Lab for force-balance derivation
majestic: Block, plane and force-colored contact; no decorative flow.
explanatory: Weight, normal, friction and net arrows, with the breakaway threshold.

name: Work–energy area and power
teacher: Compare force-position area and energy change; a large force can do zero work.
renderer: Native curves/regions + clock
color: Signed work or power, selectable and labeled in panel
majestic: Moving object and energy-colored path.
explanatory: F(x) area, energy balance and a separate power trace.

name: Impulse and one-dimensional collisions
teacher: Compare equal impulses with unequal masses; momentum conservation does not imply kinetic-energy conservation.
renderer: Native objects + analytic single-collision clock; general collisions need C1 below
majestic: Two colored bodies approach and separate.
explanatory: Momentum arrows, a finite-duration force-pulse model and impulse area.

name: Lever arm and rotational inertia
teacher: Move a force or redistribute masses; torque depends on perpendicular lever arm, inertia on mass distribution.
renderer: Native objects + arrows
color: Signed torque on the selected force marker
majestic: Minimal rotor with torque-colored marker.
explanatory: Pivot, lever arm, forces and angular-acceleration comparison.

name: Rolling race: ring vs disk
teacher: Release equal-radius bodies; mass alone does not determine which rolls faster.
renderer: Native objects + analytic clock
majestic: Two moving wheels, energy-colored sectors.
explanatory: No-slip contact, separate energy bars and synchronized displacement.

name: Skater: angular momentum and internal work
teacher: Contract a prescribed mass distribution; angular momentum can stay fixed while kinetic energy rises.
renderer: Native objects + CPU/native clock
majestic: A sparse rotating mass pattern.
explanatory: L and I comparisons; show the internal-work requirement, not an unexplained energy gain.

name: Hydrostatic pressure and buoyancy
teacher: Change depth and displaced volume; buoyancy is not set by the object’s weight alone.
renderer: Native shaded regions and force arrows; no flow in a fluid at rest
majestic: Quiet pressure-colored tank and object.
explanatory: Pressure arrows and integrated buoyancy; a free-surface rigid-body simulation would need extra machinery.

name: P–V work and thermodynamic cycles
teacher: Trace alternate paths between states; heat is not a stored state variable and cycle work depends on direction.
renderer: Native P–V curves/regions + clock; Physics Lab for energy bookkeeping
majestic: A glowing colored state trace, explicitly not gas motion.
explanatory: P–V area, Q/W/ΔU accounting and hot/cold reservoirs.

name: Heat conduction and equilibration
teacher: Compare temperature and thermal energy; heat transfer is driven by temperature difference.
renderer: Analytic temperature/heat-flux formula + native rods; a general heat solver is separate
majestic: A rod cooling with a physically colored temperature profile.
explanatory: Boundary conditions, T(x,t), heat flux and energy balance.

name: Equipotential paths and work
teacher: Take two routes between endpoints; work by electrostatic E is path-independent.
renderer: Extend existing charges preset with native paths; Physics Lab for integrals
majestic: Existing charge-potential flow, no new field invented.
explanatory: Two paths, endpoint potential and test-charge sign; fields and force remain distinct.

name: Kirchhoff current and potential map
teacher: Change a branch resistance; current is not consumed by a resistor.
renderer: Needs C2 circuit network solver for editable topology; fixed templates can be native formulas
color: Node potential; branch power available separately
majestic: A minimal circuit with potential-colored conductors and current pulses.
explanatory: Node/loop overlays, current arrows and conservation residuals.

name: RC charging and discharging
teacher: Compare initial and final states; a charging capacitor is not a steady conducting branch.
renderer: C2 for configurable networks; a fixed RC template already fits native formulas and clock
majestic: One circuit and a voltage-colored capacitor; current pulses diminish.
explanatory: q(t), I(t), energy and a switch with explicit reset semantics.

name: Lorentz force and velocity selector
teacher: Compare v parallel/perpendicular to B and E×B balance; magnetic force does no work.
renderer: C1 for general trajectories; uniform-field helices can already be drawn analytically
majestic: Sparse true trajectories, never field-line particles mislabeled as charges.
explanatory: v, E, B and force arrows, energy trace and selector exit.
cost: Needs a new capability for generality

name: Refraction and total internal reflection
teacher: Sweep incidence angle through the critical angle; refracted rays do not always exist.
renderer: Native objects for one flat interface; C3 for arbitrary interfaces
color: Optical path length along each ray, not artistic hue
majestic: A few rays and a transparent interface.
explanatory: Normals, angles, critical angle and transmitted/reflected branches.

name: Mirror and lens imaging bench
teacher: Move an object through focus; a virtual image is a ray-backprojection intersection, not a screen image.
renderer: C3 for an editable bench; fixed paraxial diagrams can already be native curves
color: Optical path length, with actual wavelength reserved for chromatic models
majestic: Few rays and optical elements.
explanatory: Principal rays, backprojections and image orientation/magnification.
cost: Needs a new capability for generality

name: Standing waves, nodes and antinodes
teacher: Change harmonic number or relative phase; standing patterns do not mean the medium travels with the pattern.
renderer: Native analytic curves + clock now; Audio Lab can analyze supplied tones, C4 adds coherent synthesis
color: Signed displacement; intensity as a separate view
majestic: A luminous moving string, colored by displacement.
explanatory: Two counterpropagating components, their sum, nodes and period.

name: Doppler wavefronts
teacher: Move a source/observer independently; perceived frequency changes without changing emission frequency.
renderer: Native analytic expanding fronts with a bounded history; C4 for coherent audible output
majestic: A small number of physical wavefronts.
explanatory: Emission events, source path, detector arrivals and measured periods.

name: Single/double-slit interference
teacher: Vary wavelength, slit spacing and width; fringe spacing and the diffraction envelope are different effects.
renderer: Native analytic intensity curve now; C4 for full phase-aware wave rendering
majestic: Luminous fringes; no advected particles presented as waves.
explanatory: Aperture geometry, phase/path difference and intensity graph; state far-field approximations.

name: Thin-film phase reversals
teacher: Change index order and thickness; an extra reflection phase can reverse bright/dark conditions.
renderer: Native two-ray/phasor diagram now; C3+C4 for layered/general optics
majestic: A film and intensity-colored reflected beam.
explanatory: Optical path, reflection phase shifts and the phasor sum.

name: Photoelectric threshold and stopping potential
teacher: Vary frequency and intensity independently; brighter subthreshold light does not eject electrons in the model.
renderer: Native objects/graphs + event animation; Physics Lab for conservation equations
majestic: Sparse emission only above threshold; color from kinetic energy.
explanatory: Kmax versus frequency, stopping potential and a separate emission-rate control.

name: Radioactive decay and half-life statistics
teacher: Repeat small samples; half-life predicts a distribution, not a timer on each identical nucleus.
renderer: Seeded analytic decay times from ClockParameters; C5 only for reusable branching/reaction events
color: Decay probability or remaining fraction, not nuclear temperature
majestic: Sparse nuclei changing state, with restrained decay flashes.
explanatory: Repeated sample counts, expectation and uncertainty; distinguish decay channels.
